inputs.prompt: Image 1 gives the exact ear frame, two diagonally arranged broom silhouettes and spacing. Image 2 is for how real broom, bucket and straw details should read in flat enamel art. Design TWO Fantasia enchanted brooms, each clearly carrying TWO pails, four pails total, in the pose and orientation of image 1. The upper broom is on the right, the lower broom at left; make both large and prominent. Each has a thick warm wood handle, well-defined curved yoke and connected bucket handles, bright warm straw bristles tapering to a sweeping skirt and four discrete red-brown pails with pale gold horizontal bands and blue water at their openings. Give each broom recognizable bristle groups and enough width between its elements to keep the outline readable. All handles join to their appropriate pails. Use ecru and gold stars in the otherwise open areas to balance both brooms. Extract only broom style from image 2, no Mickey on this side. Produce a polished FRONT VIEW, flat color-lithography master like an enamel pin illustrated as vector art. Keep the ear-shaped outside contour and bottom inward curve from image 1, at its exact position and scale. Thin even antique-gold outer rim, solid dark royal navy field, warm off-white outside. Stay comfortably inside the inner gold rim with about 1.5 mm of navy between any design and the rim. Use a compact composition that fills the upper and side areas with 6-8 broad, clearly spaced pale-gold twinkling stars sized to the gaps. Cover the available space through placement, not extra outlines. Crisp uniform dark outlines and restrained fine gold borders between large matte color areas. Use a small fixed palette of navy, cobalt blue, red, ivory, muted warm peach, golden brown and gold. Solid untextured fills suitable for conversion to a layered color image. No lettering, shadows, gleam, metallic reflections, gradients, stray marks, narrow wisps, or shapes beyond the rim.
